comment: Task T2.2 for dataset_v2: the same frozen ESM-2 encoder as representation_v1.json, pointed at dataset_v2's manifests and its own embedding cache. The encoder block is identical on purpose -- the only difference between the two datasets is which chains are reserved, so a difference in results must not also be a difference in representation.
comment_encoder: window_size is ESM-2's 1022-residue training crop; longer chains are embedded in overlapping windows whose shared positions are averaged. torch_home points at an already-populated weight cache so compute nodes need no internet.
